record: CR-01A A2 -- targeted derivation of the real engine root path

FUObjectItem::SetRootFlags.note: the RootFlags-constant hit lands at 0x1210e6a, which is a CODE CHUNK; its .pdata UNWIND_INFO has UNW_FLAG_CHAININFO and chains to the parent RUNTIME_FUNCTION at 0x1210e60. The true entry was resolved from the unwind table, not guessed.

abi: bool __fastcall f(FUObjectItem* this /*RCX*/, EInternalObjectFlags flags /*EDX*/) -> bool in AL. Confirmed in both: 'mov rbx, rcx' (this) and 'mov edi, edx' (flags); ClearRootFlags returns via 'movzx eax, sil'.
derivation_lines: 1. SOURCE SEMANTICS -- UE 5.4.4: AddToRoot (UObjectBaseUtility.h:196) -> SetRootSet (UObjectArray.h:287) -> ThisThreadAtomicallySetFlag which DISPATCHES on EInternalObjectFlags_RootFlags (UObjectArray.h:205-210) -> FUObjectItem::SetRootFlags, declared COREUOBJECT_API at UObjectArray.h:347, defined GarbageCollection.cpp:590.

2. SYMBOLIZED SAME-VERSION ORACLE -- UnrealEditor-CoreUObject.dll (UE 5.4.4) exports ?SetRootFlags@FUObjectItem@@AEAA_NW4EInternalObjectFlags@@@Z (RVA 0x371DB0) and ?ClearRootFlags@FUObjectItem@@AEAA_NW4EInternalObjectFlags@@@Z (RVA 0x2B4F50); both disassembled to extract their code shape.

3. CONFIGURATION-INVARIANT ANCHOR -- both use the immediate 0x4E100000 = EInternalObjectFlags_RootFlags (RootSet 1<<30 | AsyncLoading 1<<27 | Async 1<<26 | Native 1<<25 | LoaderImport 1<<20). This is a source-level constant, not a codegen artifact. Scanning the Shipping .text for that immediate yields 15 occurrences in 10 functions.

4. SHAPE DISCRIMINATION -- SetRootFlags: single 'test eax,0x4E100000; jne skip' followed by the distinctive disregard-for-GC check 'cmp dword[rip+X],0; setg al; test byte[rip+Y],al; jne skip'. ClearRootFlags: 'test ecx,0x4E100000; je skip' then 'not/and' then a SECOND 'test eax,0x4E100000; jne skip'. Both Shipping candidates match their editor counterparts shape-for-shape; no other candidate does.

5. INDEPENDENT STRUCTURAL CORROBORATION -- BOTH Shipping candidates take the SAME critical section: each does 'lea rcx,[rip+...]' resolving to RVA 0x7a64310 (.data) = GRootsCritical, and calls the adjacent kernel32 IAT slots (0x5dcb9b0 Enter / 0x5dcb9b8 Leave). ClearRootFlags additionally contains 'lock cmpxchg dword ptr [rbx+8], ecx', independently re-confirming FUObjectItem::Flags at +8 -- the layout used earlier -- and matching ThisThreadAtomicallyClearedFlag_ForGC.
6. GRoots STORAGE -- ClearRootFlags also references .data at RVA 0x77e1a60/0x77e1a98, the GRoots TSet storage it mutates.
why_not_ambiguous: The only chunk-level ambiguity (SetRootFlags' RootFlags hit sitting in a split code chunk) was resolved by following UNW_FLAG_CHAININFO in the unwind table to the parent RUNTIME_FUNCTION, which is a deterministic, reproducible resolution rather than an inference. Both functions are real, callable, out-of-line code -- unlike FMemory::Realloc/Free, which are fully inlined in this build and therefore have no address at all.
no_manual_gc_internals: The runtime will CALL these engine functions. It will not reimplement GRoots, GRootsCritical, the RootSet bit manipulation, or the reachability barrier -- all of which live inside SetRootFlags/ClearRootFlags.
